summary: Testing of new Ranking Semanal, Mensal, and Destaque do Mês features. All 7 requested features verified and working correctly. Backend APIs return correct data structure and frontend UI displays all components properly.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Using existing athlete data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New ranking features are complete and working: semanal, mensal, destaque-mes APIs and RankingDestaques.jsx component all verified.

1_api_ranking_semanal.description: GET /api/ranking/semanal?categoria={categoria} returns weekly ranking with periodo, categoria, and ranking array. Top 10 limit enforced. Tested all categories: masculino, feminino, pcd-m, pcd-f, cadeirante-m, cadeirante-f.

2_api_ranking_mensal.description: GET /api/ranking/mensal?categoria={categoria}&mes={mes}&ano={ano} returns monthly ranking with mes (month name in Portuguese), ano, categoria, and ranking array. Supports custom month/year parameters. Top 10 limit enforced.

3_api_destaque_mes.description: GET /api/ranking/destaque-mes returns month highlights with: mes, ano, total_corridas_mes, destaques_categoria (all 6 categories with top 3 each), mais_ativo_mes, mais_pontos_mes. Structure verified and all data types validated.

4_frontend_destaque_card.description: Card 'Destaque de Fevereiro 2026' displays on main ranking page with: corridas count, atletas no pódio count, 'Mais Ativo' section with athlete name and corridas, 'Mais Pontos' section with athlete name and points.

5_frontend_rankings_periodo.description: Section 'Rankings por Período' with Semanal and Mensal tabs. Tab switching works correctly. Semanal shows 'Período: YYYY-MM-DD a YYYY-MM-DD', Mensal shows 'Mês de Ano'.

6_frontend_top3_medals.description: Top 3 athletes displayed with medal icons (gold=yellow, silver=slate, bronze=amber). 3 medal icons found in ranking section. Position ordering verified (1, 2, 3).

7_frontend_toggle_destaques.description: Button 'Ver Destaques' / 'Ocultar Destaques' in filters sidebar toggles visibility of destaques section. Text changes correctly. Destaque card visibility confirmed to toggle on button click.
